game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Misty Bog Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Misty Bog, a misty bog: the forest ranger must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Misty Bog: a misty bog
core_gameplay_loop: In Misty Bog, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round, a new spirit lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of spirit lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Roll Call Enumerate' (Week 5 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Misty Bog'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how roll_call changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Misty Bog.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 46 seconds.
